newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Five killed in Brazil jailbreak attempt.
newsitem.headline: Five killed in Brazil jailbreak attempt.

text.p: Five people were killed on Wednesday when inmates hijacked a garbage truck and tried to ram the gates of Latin America's largest prison, a military police spokesman said.
Four inmates in the truck were shot dead by guards at Carandiru prison in downtown Sao Paulo while a prison worker was killed after being run over by the truck.
Another group of prisoners took 27 hostages, two of whom were later released for health reasons, and demanded transfers to another penitentiary, the spokesman said.
Negotiations broke off on Wednesday evening and were to be resumed early on Thursday, private CBN radio said.
With some 6,300 inmates and more than 1,000 guards and administrative staff, Carandiru is Latin America's largest prison complex.

In May, 53 inmates escaped from the penitentiary after digging a 100-yard (metre) tunnel under prison walls. Carandiru is also the site of Brazil's most violent riot, where 111 inmates were shot dead by military police in October 1992.
During the prison melee a passerby was mistaken for one of the fugitives and captured and beaten by prison guards, the police spokesman said.
"It seems that someone passing was wearing clothes very similar to the prisoners' uniform. He was taken by the guards into the prison and beaten," the spokesman said.
The civilian is now under observation in a nearby hospital, he added.
